limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.

implementation: Eight-state FSM; entry into B does not sample w. Each subsequent group of three samples produces a one-cycle result, with no gap between groups. Active-high synchronous reset returns to A.

static_review: Explicit enum if/else transitions, complete combinational defaults, nonblocking sequential assignments, unchanged required interface and cycle semantics.
